summary: DeepSeek released DeepSeek-Coder-V2, an open-source MoE code language model continued-pretrained from DeepSeek-V2 with 6 trillion additional tokens, extending context length to 128K and expanding supported programming languages, claiming performance comparable to GPT-4-Turbo on coding and math benchmarks.

mechanisms.reason: The model's context window was extended eightfold, increasing KV-cache and memory demand per served instance.
mechanisms.quote: extending the context length from 16K to 128K

practices.reason: An open-weight coding model claiming parity with closed frontier models on code and math benchmarks with much longer context is worth evaluating for self-hosted coding assistants, though the benchmark comparisons are the lab's own.
practices.quote: DeepSeek-Coder-V2 achieves superior performance compared to closed-source models such as GPT4-Turbo, Claude 3 Opus, and Gemini 1.5 Pro in coding and math benchmarks

notable_reason: An open-source model reportedly matching closed frontier models like GPT-4-Turbo on coding and math benchmarks, with a large context extension, is a meaningful open-weights milestone.
